title: Dogfood until work is not lost; a stop for approval is a failure (2026-10-25)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
Ok, add these. 
But we are dogfooding. So  we  must continue this work until we know that we are following our process, and our work would be found. And continued.

So do all the logging required. 
And know that every time you stop for a pr that I have to approve before we reach the goal, we have failed 

So let's work out what needs to be done, plan, review and preapprove and then dogfood until we know work is not lost when it follows the defined process and any new agent knows how to find the process
